title: Variance Reduction with Delayed Feedback for Non-Convex Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.28510v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study variance reduction for non-convex optimization when gradient evaluations return with a delay. The server can update the parameter while earlier evaluations remain unfinished. We first analyze an ordered recursive momentum estimator for stochastic optimization. Under average smoothness and bounded variance, its oracle complexity is $O(1+\sigma^2\epsilon^{-2}+L\Delta_f(1+\sigma/\epsilon+\tau)\epsilon^{-2})$, where the target is an expected squared gradient norm of at most $\epsilon^2$ and $\tau$ bounds the feedback delay. We next study finite sums with $n$ components and obtain $O(n+L\Delta_f(\sqrt n+\min\{\tau,n-1\})\epsilon^{-2})$ evaluations. An asynchronous snapshot variant continues updating during full-gradient computations under an explicit bound on their completion time. For the stochastic method, we further replace a maximum-delay bound by a bound on the weighted amount of missing feedback.

translated_title: 非凸优化中带延迟反馈的方差缩减
translated_abstract: 我们研究了梯度评估延迟返回时非凸优化的方差缩减问题。服务器可以在先前的评估尚未完成时继续更新参数。我们首先分析了用于随机优化的有序递推动量估计器。在平均光滑性和有界方差的条件下，其预言机复杂度为 $O(1+\sigma^2\epsilon^{-2}+L\Delta_f(1+\sigma/\epsilon+\tau)\epsilon^{-2})$，其中目标是将期望梯度范数平方降至至多 $\epsilon^2$，$\tau$ 为反馈延迟的上界。接下来我们研究了具有 $n$ 个分量的有限和问题，得到了 $O(n+L\Delta_f(\sqrt n+\min\{\tau,n-1\})\epsilon^{-2})$ 次评估的复杂度。我们还提出了一种异步快照变体，在全梯度计算的完成时间满足显式上界的条件下，可在全梯度计算期间继续更新参数。对于随机方法，我们进一步用缺失反馈的加权总量上界替代了最大延迟上界。
tldr: 该论文针对梯度评估存在延迟的非凸优化问题，提出了基于有序递推动量估计器的方差缩减方法及其异步快照变体，并在延迟上界或缺失反馈加权总量上界的条件下给出了改进的预言机复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes variance reduction methods for non-convex optimization with delayed gradient feedback—based on an ordered recursive momentum estimator and an asynchronous snapshot variant—achieving improved oracle complexities under bounds on either the delay or the weighted amount of missing feedback.
